name: Aimend

attributes.attribute: daughter of a king of the Corcu Loigde
a historical people of south-west Ireland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aimend was an Irish goddess. She is an obscure figure who appears to have been an early solar divinity. Early Irish legend names her the child of a Corcu Loigde king. The Corcu Loigde were a historical people of the south-west of Ireland. The circumstances of her story imply that she was a sun goddess.

okr.objective: Record Aimend, an obscure Irish solar goddess.
key_results: Document Aimend as an early solar divinity.
Record her as a daughter of a king of the Corcu Loigde.
Note that her story implies a sun-goddess role.
